description: Search MENA jobs with every verified filter, newest first.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description:
**Country filter:** 2-letter ISO code, e.g. `ae` or `sa`.
Get valid markets and live counts from `/countries` or `/market-facets` (`countries` facet).

**Multiple values:** comma-separate values such as `ae,sa`; matches are OR-ed.

**Different filters combine with AND.** For example, `country=ae&career_level=2` keeps jobs matching
both filters.

An unknown market code returns 0 jobs; check `/countries` when a result is unexpectedly empty.

**Free-text post-filter:** case-insensitive match against title, description snippet and summaries.

Examples: `nurse`, `sales manager`, `python`.

All words in a multi-word value must occur; `sales manager` matches either word order.

This scans only the requested window, not the full corpus. Narrow with location or taxonomy
filters first; use `/autocomplete` to discover job-title terms.

**Post-filter:** applied to the jobs scanned for this request, not the whole index.

It scans `scan_pages` pages (default `3`, max `10`) and reports `jobsScanned`, `jobsMatched` and
`scanTruncated` in `postFilter`. `count` remains the pre-post-filter total.

For coverage, narrow first with `country`, `city`, `industry`, `career_level` or `date_posted`.

Examples: `nurse`, `sales manager`, `python`.

All words in a multi-word value must occur; `sales manager` matches either word order.

It scans `scan_pages` pages (default `3`, max `10`) and reports `jobsScanned`, `jobsMatched` and
`scanTruncated` in `postFilter`. `count` remains the pre-post-filter total.

For coverage, narrow first with `country`, `city`, `industry`, `career_level` or `date_posted`.

company.description:
**Employer slug  -  required.** Lower case and hyphenated, e.g. `accenture`; display names do not match.
Get the slug from `/market-facets` → `companies[].value`.

**Multiple values:** comma-separate values such as `ae,sa`; matches are OR-ed.

**Different filters combine with AND.** For example, `country=ae&career_level=2` keeps jobs matching
both filters.

An unknown market code returns 0 jobs; check `/countries` when a result is unexpectedly empty.

province.description:

truncated ids such as `Dubai` or `ae,4` return 400.

**Multiple values:** use a pipe because ids contain commas, e.g. `ae,4,0|eg,2,0`; values are OR-ed.

Combines with other filters using AND.

city.description:
**City filter:** composite id `country,province,city`, e.g. `ae,4,0` (Dubai) or `eg,2,10`.
Copy the exact id from `/cities` or the `cities` facet of `/market-facets`; names and truncated
ids return 400.

**Multiple values:** use a pipe, e.g. `ae,4,0|eg,2,10`; values are OR-ed.

Use one city at a time to page through a large country.

career_level.description:
**Career level:** one or more ids: `0` Student/Internship, `1` Entry, `2` Mid career, `3` Management,
`4` Director/Head, `5` Senior executive, `6` Fresh graduate.
Get values and labels from `/taxonomy` or the `careerLevels` facet of `/market-facets`.

**Multiple values:** comma-separate values such as `ae,sa`; matches are OR-ed.

Only postings declaring a level match; omit it for maximum recall.

employment_type.description:
**Employment type:** `1` Full time, `2` Internship, `3` Contractor, `4` Temporary, `5` Part time,
`6` Freelance. Values and labels are available from `/taxonomy` or `/market-facets`.

**Multiple values:** comma-separate values; matches are OR-ed.

Only postings declaring a type match; omit it for maximum recall.

industry.description:

Get current ids and labels from `/taxonomy` or the `industries` facet of `/market-facets`.

**Multiple values:** comma-separate values; matches are OR-ed.

Use it to split a broad country search into pageable slices.

remote_only.description:

gender.description:

citizenship.description:

**Multiple values:** comma-separate values; matches are OR-ed.

Only a minority of postings declare this field, so results can be small.

company_type.description:
